title: B2B MarTech & Account Intelligence Enricher (v24.0)
description: Deep MarTech stack audit (GTM container unpacking, runtime GA4 duplicate detection, sGTM, EU Consent Mode v2 gaps), active ad spend intelligence (Google Ads Transparency RPC), 3-tier verification (CSP vs Code vs Runtime), decoupled Opportunity Score & Contactability, and GDPR / German §7 UWG compliance.

domains.sectionCaption: 1. Target Domains, Scan Mode & Output Format
domains.sectionDescription: Provide target company domains or URLs to audit their MarTech stack, ad activity, decision-makers, and compliance status.
domains.title: Target Domains / URLs
domains.description: List of company domains or URLs to enrich (e.g., 'intertop.ua', 'https://www.notino.de', 'bergfreunde.de').

scanMode.title: Scan Execution Mode
scanMode.description: Choose 'full_audit' to allow Playwright headless browser fallback when needed, or 'fast_http_only' for sub-second browserless HTTP/TLS/DNS execution (ideal for large batches and Standby API).

outputView.title: Output Dataset View
outputView.description: Choose 'full_audit' for all 132 technical & compliance columns, or 'sdr_compact' for a clean 34-column CRM-ready outbound view.

disableDeepOsint.title: Disable 2-Wave Deep OSINT DAG (Minimal HTTP Mode)
disableDeepOsint.description: By default (false), runs fast browserless OSINT waves: TLS X.509 SANs, DoH DNS/DKIM/DMARC/SEG, Google Ads Transparency RPC, Wikidata, VIES/GLEIF, RDAP, and M365 AD email verification. Check to disable.

skipUnqualifiedInOutput.title: Exclude Unreachable / NXDOMAIN Domains from Output Dataset
skipUnqualifiedInOutput.description: If enabled, domains that fail DNS resolution or SSRF checks with zero data quality score are omitted from the output dataset.

defaultPhoneRegion.title: Default Phone Region Fallback
defaultPhoneRegion.description: ISO 2-letter country code used when a domain TLD is generic (.com, .io, .store) and language hints are ambiguous.

serperApiKey.sectionCaption: 2. Optional LinkedIn X-Ray & Email Verifier Keys
serperApiKey.sectionDescription: Connect Serper.dev to discover operational CMO / Head of Marketing LinkedIn profiles, and Reoon / MillionVerifier for live SMTP verification of predicted DM emails.
serperApiKey.title: Serper.dev API Key (CMO / Head of Marketing LinkedIn X-Ray)
serperApiKey.description: Optional API key from serper.dev. Automatically finds CMO / Head of Digital / Marketing Director on LinkedIn when the website only lists legal CEOs or general inboxes.

reoonApiKey.title: Reoon Email Verifier API Key
reoonApiKey.description: Optional API key from reoon.com. Verifies predicted DM email patterns in real time and promotes deliverable addresses to best_email.

millionVerifierApiKey.title: MillionVerifier API Key
millionVerifierApiKey.description: Optional API key from millionverifier.com (alternative to Reoon for live verification of predicted DM emails).

forceFreshScan.sectionCaption: 3. Cache Freshness, Anti-Bot WAF & Webhook Integration
forceFreshScan.sectionDescription: Control snapshot cache TTL, force Playwright rendering on strict WAF domains, or push results directly to n8n / Make / Clay / HubSpot / Slack.
forceFreshScan.title: Force 100% Fresh Live Scan (Ignore Cache)
forceFreshScan.description: If enabled, completely bypasses prior cached snapshots in Key-Value Store and performs a strictly live scan.

maxCacheAgeDays.title: Maximum Cache Age (Days)
maxCacheAgeDays.description: Maximum allowed age (in days) for fallback cache snapshots. Set to 0 to disable cache reads.

bypassHopelessWaf.title: Force Playwright on Strict WAF Domains (Bypass Hopeless List)
bypassHopelessWaf.description: If enabled, forces Playwright browser rendering even on known strict DataDome/Cloudflare domains (coolblue.nl, zalando.de, otto.de, grammarly.com).

webhookUrl.title: Outbound Webhook URL (n8n / Make / Clay / CRM / Slack)
webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL. When the run finishes, the Actor automatically sends a JSON POST payload containing run telemetry and enriched account records.

scanContactPages.sectionDescription: Fine-tune subpage crawling, GTM container unpacking, concurrency, and Apify Proxy settings.
scanContactPages.title: Crawl Contact, About & Impressum Subpages
scanContactPages.description: Automatically discovers and scans /contact, /about, /team, /b2b, and /impressum pages for executive names and B2B emails.

unpackGtmContainers.title: Unpack Raw GTM Container JS (gtm.js)
unpackGtmContainers.description: Downloads and inspects raw Google Tag Manager container code to detect hidden GA4 measurement IDs, ad pixels, and duplicate tagging.

maxConcurrency.title: Max HTTP Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel fast HTTP workers (curl_cffi).

maxBrowserConcurrency.title: Max Playwright Browser Concurrency
maxBrowserConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel headless browser contexts for JS rendering (2 is optimal for 2048 MB RAM).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Residential proxies are automatically used for WAF escalation if available on your account.
